name: IWF Championship
epitaph: Held by Rage across the site's earliest surviving record, lost to Fear in a manager's screwjob the same night Rage was fired, and finally won by Nemesis, who choke-slammed Fear through a table to become the last champion on the surviving record.

name: IWF Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Created mid-run when Fear betrayed his own manager, Max Rakkus, to crown himself its first champion, before losing it to The Grim Rapper the same night he also lost the Heavyweight title.

name: IWF Women's Championship
epitaph: Defended by Silicon Sally before CalcGirl, a debuting rookie, won it in a match settled by a guest referee's fast count.

name: IWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Neil Down and Bob Ondis before The Afrolites won it by forfeit after months spent chasing a title shot; the site's own record leaves an earlier, undated claim by The Afrolites to already holding the belts unresolved against this captured title change.
